Vera: quick RFC follow-up: propose we adopt a minimalist probe-only shim as the canonical handoff surface across hosted/dedicated/private. shrink responsibilities: probe/capabilities, routing hints, trace/request-id passthrough. no state, no secret store.

Ike: sounds good; two hard risks: private HSM header injection and streamed chunk fidelity.

Vera: mitigations: operator-managed injector for private (helm chart + manifest) so operator keeps keys; hosted/dedicated use short-lived token exchange via authz service. shim will never hold key material.

Noah: for streaming parity we need a binary-chunk diff tool in the harness. plan: capture golden streams, replay through shim and legacy facade, fail if any chunk boundary differs. add this to CI gates for canaries.

Priya: rollout phases: 1) hosted internal alpha (ff on) 2) hosted public canary (2w baseline) 3) dedicated opt-ins (exclude HSM tenants) 4) private via operator install + migration window 5) GA flip after 12w stable. LB-level kill-switch to route back to legacy facade required.

Ike: compatibility handshake should be tiny: e.g., {"capabilities":["stream:framed","kv:v3"],"probe":true}. shim will refuse incompatible runtimes and either route to legacy or return 409 with migration hint.

Noah: add manifest-lint rule to flag facade-only fields and a preflight check during Dedicated provisioning. ops-bot: please schedule baseline + snapshot jobs.

ops-bot: jobs created: handoff-baseline-183333 (daily) and handoff-snapshot-183333 (retention=30d). link: https://ci.redwood/handoff/183333

Priya: CI plan: prototype (7d), harness & streaming diff (5d), hosted alpha (2w), dedicated beta opt-ins (3w), private operator docs (2w), GA flip after 12w monitoring. will draft rollout playbook and parity checklist. tagging @security for operator/HSM review.
